verdict.rationale: LM Studio's Bionic agent can be directed in natural language, including real-time local speech transcription, to create and edit documents and run agentic tasks with MCP tools. A hands-on user says it 'works great.' However, operating LM Studio itself (loading models, configuring the server, managing settings) is documented only through the GUI and `lms` CLI flags, not natural-language commands, and one user reported the MCP agent flow looping endlessly. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core product operations like model management and server configuration, plus more robust independent corroboration of reliable agentic execution.
